scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0111; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘What do you mean?’ and ‘I mean this part.’ are natural short uses of the intended sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian wording preserves the intended meaning of mean as conveying an intended message.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast nearby curriculum targets rather than arbitrary strings.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: The question form is familiar and learner turns remain short for A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner turn changes from asking about intent to identifying the intended part.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario and assessment remain within one bounded meaning of mean.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or learner test has been performed.
